name: Grants Application Access
description: An IAM Identity Center application assignment gives one user or group access to one application (assignment -> application): the application ARN in the assignment. The assignment has no ARN of its own and is keyed by the application, the principal type and the principal id. A reference, not containment. Emitted whether or not the application was collected: it resolves by deterministic identity (the application ARN) when it is.
